sentence: Weed the bed along the side of the house, and clean up the front yard and the backyard.

observation.model_notes: No photo shows a side gate, so equipment access width to the side/back yard can't be confirmed. Photo 1 only shows one stretch of the side bed against the siding; whether it continues further toward the back is unknown. Photo 3 shows an in-ground/deck-level pool and a shed in the backyard, neither of which is part of a standard yard cleanup scope. Only one photo covers each of front_yard and backyard, so cleanup severity is based on a single vantage point per section.

counting_evidence.note: One continuous mulch/planting bed runs along the visible stretch of the house's side, from the foundation to the brick edging near the sidewalk.

evidence.note: Grass and broadleaf weeds (including white-flowered clover/weeds) have grown up through the mulch along most of the bed's length.
Mulch coverage is thin/patchy in several spots where weeds and grass have taken over, and a shovel is staged in the bed, suggesting work has started or is planned.

service_lines.uncertain: The bed's full length beyond the framing of this photo (further down the side yard) is not shown.

evidence.note: Lawn is green, mowed, and even; driveway and walkway are clear of debris.
Foundation shrubs and the flowering tree near the porch appear maintained, no visible overgrowth encroaching on the walkway.

service_lines.uncertain: No close-up of the lawn edges, flower beds near the porch, or areas out of frame (e.g. side of the front yard) to confirm whether debris or leaf litter is present there.

evidence.note: Lawn is mowed but shows mixed green and brown/dry patches across the yard.
No visible trash, fallen branches, or large debris on the grass; shed and deck area appear clear.

service_lines.uncertain: Cause of the brown/dry patches (e.g. thatch, dead grass, mowing pattern) can't be determined from the photo, so it's unclear how much cleanup work, if any, this represents beyond normal mowing.
